title: Cursor tells lawmakers it is considering phasing out Chinese open-weight AI models due to "geopolitical risk"; Cursor's Composer 2 was built on Kimi K2.5 (Kai Nicol-Schwarz/CNBC)
summary: Kai Nicol-Schwarz / CNBC: Cursor tells lawmakers it is considering phasing out Chinese open-weight AI models due to “geopolitical risk”; Cursor's Composer 2 was built on Kimi K2.5 — SpaceX's artificial-intelligence coding platform, Cursor, is considering moving away from using of Chinese AI models due to “geopolitical risk,” CNBC has learned.
contentText:
Kai Nicol-Schwarz / CNBC :

Cursor tells lawmakers it is considering phasing out Chinese open-weight AI models due to “geopolitical risk”; Cursor's Composer 2 was built on Kimi K2.5   —  SpaceX's artificial-intelligence coding platform, Cursor, is considering moving away from using of Chinese AI models due to “geopolitical risk,” CNBC has learned.
